sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: All over New York City, there are semi-clothed or nude women.
sentences.zh: 在整个纽约市，到处都是衣着清凉或赤裸的女性。

sentences.en: And they are so baked into architecture that we don't even see them.
sentences.zh: 她们与建筑融为一体，以至于我们甚至注意不到她们。

sentences.en: For example, when you enter the New York Public Library, on the left-hand side,
sentences.zh: 例如，当你走进纽约公共图书馆时，在左手边，

sentences.en: there's a sculpture of a young woman leaning against a horse.
sentences.zh: 有一尊年轻女性靠着马的雕塑。

sentences.en: On 59th and 5th, there's a statue of a woman holding a basket of fruit.
sentences.zh: 在第59街和第5大道交汇处，有一尊女性手持一篮水果的雕像。

sentences.en: On 107th Street and Broadway, there's a woman reclining on a bed.
sentences.zh: 在第107街和百老汇大道，有一个躺在床上的女人。

sentences.en: That's former New Yorker Avery Troubleman.
sentences.zh: 那是前纽约人艾弗里·特鲁布尔曼。

sentences.en: At 100th and Riverside Drive, a stone woman sits in a chair with a child.
sentences.zh: 在第100街和河滨大道，一个石雕妇女抱着孩子坐在一张椅子上。

sentences.en: And on the very top of the New York Municipal Building, there's a golden woman holding a crown.
sentences.zh: 而在纽约市政厅的顶端，有一个手持王冠的金衣女性。

sentences.en: And these women are actually the same woman.
sentences.zh: 而这些女性实际上都是同一个人。

sentences.en: Audrey Munson was the most famous artist model in the United States.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽·芒森曾是美国最著名的艺术家模特。

sentences.en: Over 30 statues at the Met are made in her likeness,
sentences.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆里有30多尊以她的面貌创作的雕像，

sentences.en: and she adorns dozens of memorials and bridges and regal buildings all over New York City.
sentences.zh: 纽约市各处的无数纪念碑、桥梁和庄严建筑上都有她的装饰雕塑。

sentences.en: She basically was the equivalent of a supermodel at the time.
sentences.zh: 她基本上就是那个时代的超级名模的化身。

sentences.en: This is Andrea Geyer, an artist herself and author of Queen of the Artist Studios, the story of Audrey Munson.
sentences.zh: 这位是安德烈·盖尔，她本人也是一位艺术家，同时也是《艺术家工作室女王：奥黛丽·芒森的故事》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Everybody knew who she was.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道她是谁。

sentences.en: Her picture was in the papers.
sentences.zh: 她的照片登上了各大报纸。

sentences.en: And if one trusts legend, like, oh, every boy had a crush on her.
sentences.zh: 如果传说可信的话，可以说是几乎每个男孩都暗恋过她。

sentences.en: She was a very desired young woman.
sentences.zh: 她是一个备受追捧的年轻女性。

sentences.en: In her lifetime, she would go on to decorate buildings and memorials all over the United States
sentences.zh: 在她的一生中，她为全美各地的建筑和纪念碑进行装饰，

sentences.en: before becoming a movie star and eventually getting embroiled in a sensational murder scandal.
sentences.zh: 后来成为一名电影明星，最终却卷入了一起轰动一时的谋杀丑闻。

sentences.en: And although Audrey Munson's body has been immortalized in iron and marble,
sentences.zh: 尽管奥黛丽·芒森的身体已被铁铸和大理石永远铭记，

sentences.en: her name is mostly forgotten.
sentences.zh: 但她的名字却大多已被遗忘。

sentences.en: But she was a prolific writer and penned a series of articles telling her life in her own words,
sentences.zh: 不过她是一位多产的作家，曾撰写了一系列文章，用她自己的话讲述自己的人生，

sentences.en: sometimes Anne the third person.
sentences.zh: 有时是以第三人称安妮的口吻。

sentences.en: Where is she now?
sentences.zh: 她现在在哪里？

sentences.en: This model who was so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这位曾经如此美丽的模特。

sentences.en: What has been her reward?
sentences.zh: 她得到了什么回报？

sentences.en: Is she happy and prosperous?
sentences.zh: 她现在幸福且富足吗？

sentences.en: Or is she sad and forlorn?
sentences.zh: 还是悲伤而孤苦伶仃？

sentences.en: Her beauty gone.
sentences.zh: 她的美貌已经消逝。

sentences.en: Leaving only memories in the wake.
sentences.zh: 只留下一片回忆。

sentences.en: Like so many supermodels that would come after her,
sentences.zh: 就像后来出现的那么多超级名模一样，

sentences.en: Audrey Marie Munson was scouted on the streets of New York City in 1906.
sentences.zh: 1906年，奥黛丽·玛丽·芒森在纽约市的街头被星探发掘。

sentences.en: Audrey's mother and father were divorced, which was very unusual at the time,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽的父母离异了，这在当时非常罕见，

sentences.en: and her mother decided to get a fresh start in the big city.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲决定在大城市开启崭新的生活。

sentences.en: Audrey was 15, enrolled in music school, and one day...
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽当时15岁，在音乐学校注册就读，而有一天……

sentences.en: She was picked up on the street by a photographer when she walked around with her mother.
sentences.zh: 当她和母亲在街上散步时，被一位摄影师在街头相中。

sentences.en: This photographer gave Audrey his card and asked if she would pose for some portraits.
sentences.zh: 这位摄影师给了奥黛丽他的名片，并问她是否愿意为一些肖像照当模特。

sentences.en: Her mom was invited too, so intentions were good.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲也被邀请了，所以对方的意图是好的。

sentences.en: These photos were fully clothed affairs.
sentences.zh: 这些照片都是穿着衣服拍摄的。

sentences.en: Audrey, by chance, was picked up as a model and then in the studio proved that she was somebody
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽机缘巧合下成为了一名模特，随后在工作室里证明了自己，

sentences.en: who was very good with the camera, very good in creating and generating poses.
sentences.zh: 她非常适应镜头，极擅长摆出各种姿势。

sentences.en: This photographer recommended that Audrey meet a friend of his, the famous sculptor Isidore Conte.
sentences.zh: 这位摄影师建议奥黛丽去见他的朋友，著名雕塑家伊西多尔·孔特。

sentences.en: At first, Conte thought he didn't really need Audrey.
sentences.zh: 起初，孔特认为自己其实并不需要奥黛丽。

sentences.en: But, as Audrey herself later recalled...
sentences.zh: 但是，正如奥黛丽后来回忆的那样……

sentences.en: Suddenly, he rose from the table, walked about me, asked me to stand and walk, and then said that he thought he could use me.
sentences.zh: 突然，他从桌旁站起来，围着我走了一圈，让我站起来走走，然后说他觉得他用得上我。

sentences.en: But, said Mr. Conte, you will have to pose in the altogether.
sentences.zh: 不过，孔特先生说，你必须全裸摆姿势。

sentences.en: Posing in the altogether meant posing naked.
sentences.zh: 全裸摆姿势意味着一丝不挂地摆姿势。

sentences.en: Audrey's mother consented.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽的母亲同意了。

sentences.en: If they would have been wealthy people, I don't think her mother would have let her pose in the nude.
sentences.zh: 如果她们是有钱人家的话，我想她母亲是不会让她裸体当模特的。

sentences.en: From that encounter, the resulting sculpture was the three muses.
sentences.zh: 那次见面催生出的雕塑作品就是《三美神》。

sentences.en: Three nude women with their arms around each other.
sentences.zh: 三个裸体女性互相搂着手臂。

sentences.en: All three modeled after Audrey.
sentences.zh: 这三位都是以奥黛丽为原型创作的。

sentences.en: For decades, the sculpture was in the lobby of the Hotel Astor.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这座雕塑一直摆放在阿斯托尔酒店的大堂里。

sentences.en: Audrey called this statue, quote,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽将这座雕像称为，引述：

sentences.en: A souvenir of my mother's consent.
sentences.zh: “我母亲同意的纪念品。”

sentences.en: And this was the first of many sculptures that she would model for Isidore Conte.
sentences.zh: 这是她为伊西多尔·孔特担任模特的众多雕塑中的第一件。

sentences.en: Audrey began to work for many other famous artists in New York.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽开始为纽约许多其他著名艺术家工作。

sentences.en: As her reputation grew, she was recommended from studio to studio,
sentences.zh: 随着她的名气越来越大，她被各个工作室相互推荐，

sentences.en: and slowly, her likeness appeared, mostly naked or half-naked, all over the city.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，她的形象——大多全裸或半裸——出现在城市的各个角落。

sentences.en: In 1913, the New York Sun dubbed her Miss Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 1913年，《纽约太阳报》称她为“曼哈顿小姐”。

sentences.en: But Audrey is not always recognizable in sculpture.
sentences.zh: 但在雕塑中，人们并不总能一眼认出奥黛丽。

sentences.en: Her figure is different in different artists' eyes.
sentences.zh: 在不同艺术家的眼中，她的身材各不相同。

sentences.en: Sometimes she's lithe.
sentences.zh: 有时她身姿苗条。

sentences.en: Sometimes she's fuller.
sentences.zh: 有时她体态丰满。

sentences.en: From sculpture to sculpture, there are no obvious giveaways that you're looking at Audrey's body.
sentences.zh: 从一件雕塑到另一件雕塑，并没有明显的迹象表明你看到的就是奥黛丽的身体。

sentences.en: The clues are in her face.
sentences.zh: 线索在于她的面部。

sentences.en: It's the expressions of the eyes and the mouth and the nose.
sentences.zh: 那是眼睛、嘴巴和鼻子的神态。

sentences.en: Like, once you know how she looks, you can see her everywhere.
sentences.zh: 比如，一旦你知道了她的长相，你就能在各处看到她。

sentences.en: It's really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很迷人。

sentences.en: I would, like, look at sculptures in the mat and be like,
sentences.zh: 我会在大都会艺术博物馆里看着雕塑然后心想，

sentences.en: that looks like her, and then research and be, yeah, be right, that was her.
sentences.zh: 那看起来像她，然后一查资料发现，确实没错，那就是她。

sentences.en: Before it was easy for artists to snap a reference picture,
sentences.zh: 在艺术家们可以轻松抓拍参考照片之前，

sentences.en: Audrey could pose in a way that could evoke a mood.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽能够通过摆姿势来唤起某种情绪。

sentences.en: She must have been a very empathetic person.
sentences.zh: 她一定是一个极具同理心的人。

sentences.en: She could really translate emotion fully into her body.
sentences.zh: 她真的能把情感完全转化为肢体语言。

sentences.en: Audrey could hold the same pose for hours, sometimes for an entire day.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽可以保持同一个姿势几个小时，有时甚至是一整天。

sentences.en: And she worked closely with the artists, learning their temperaments,
sentences.zh: 她与艺术家们紧密合作，了解他们的脾气，

sentences.en: familiarizing herself with their past work.
sentences.zh: 熟悉他们过去的艺术作品。

sentences.en: She thought of herself as a collaborator, as she told the New York Herald in 1915.
sentences.zh: 她视自己为合作者，正如她在1915年对《纽约先驱报》所说的那样。

sentences.en: Study?
sentences.zh: 学习？

sentences.en: Yes, indeed I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实这么做。

sentences.en: Every model who is a real success must study the work of the persons she is with.
sentences.zh: 每一个真正成功的模特都必须研究与她合作之人的作品。

sentences.en: Audrey's unique set of skills earned her a decent salary, about $35 a week,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽独特的一技之长为她赢得了不错的薪水，大约每周35美元，

sentences.en: which today would be like $800 a week.
sentences.zh: 这在今天相当于每周800美元左右。

sentences.en: She made enough to give a day's salary to the suffragist movement,
sentences.zh: 她赚的钱足够捐出一天的薪水给女性选举权运动，

sentences.en: which was in full swing around her.
sentences.zh: 当时这场运动正在她身边如火如荼地进行着。

sentences.en: Audrey was an independent, confident woman at a good time to be a sculpture model.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽是一个独立、自信的女性，而当时正是一个当雕塑模特的好时代。

sentences.en: Because the architecture that was in vogue in the United States from the end of the 19th century
sentences.zh: 因为自19世纪末到第一次世界大战期间，

sentences.en: through World War I was the Beaux-Arts style.
sentences.zh: 美国流行建筑风格是美术字风格（学院派风格/巴黎美术学院风格）。

sentences.en: And this style required a lot of sculptures and detailed ornamentation.
sentences.zh: 这种风格需要大量的雕塑和细致的装饰。

sentences.en: It was a great time in many ways to be an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 从很多方面来说，这都是成为一名艺术家的好时代。

sentences.en: This is architectural historian Karen McNeil.
sentences.zh: 这位是建筑历史学家凯伦·麦克尼尔。

sentences.en: Whether you were an architect, a sculptor, a painter, a craftsperson making lamps.
sentences.zh: 无论你是一名建筑师、雕塑家、画家，还是制作灯具的手工艺人。

sentences.en: You've seen Beaux-Arts style architecture.
sentences.zh: 你都见过美术学院派风格的建筑。

sentences.en: Virtually all state capitals are in this style.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的州首府建筑都是这种风格。

sentences.en: That image of an authoritative building with columns and statues all around,
sentences.zh: 那种带有柱子和四周雕像的权威建筑形象，

sentences.en: maybe a big dome, that's Beaux-Arts.
sentences.zh: 可能还有一个巨大的穹顶，那就是美术学院派风格。

sentences.en: The style is a cross between like stately Greek Parthenon and flowery French Versailles.
sentences.zh: 这种风格介于庄严的希腊帕台农神庙和华丽的法国凡尔赛宫之间。

sentences.en: So a Beaux-Arts building, it's a Greek temple, but then you do have the sculptures on it.
sentences.zh: 所以一座美术学院派建筑，它是一个希腊神庙，但上面确实有雕塑。

sentences.en: You do have the frieze work.
sentences.zh: 上面确实有带状雕刻。

sentences.en: You do have all of this ornamental detail that is integral to the building.
sentences.zh: 确实有所有这些构成了建筑整体一部分的装饰细节。

sentences.en: And architecture and sculpture are really bound together in this movement.
sentences.zh: 在这场运动中，建筑与雕塑真正地结合在了一起。

sentences.en: When you take the decorative elements off of a Beaux-Arts building,
sentences.zh: 当你把美术学院派建筑上的装饰元素去掉时，

sentences.en: it looks weird.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就很怪异。

sentences.en: The dimensions don't quite work anymore.
sentences.zh: 尺寸比例看起来就不太对劲了。

sentences.en: But also, the sculptures are signs of the building's purpose.
sentences.zh: 而且，这些雕塑也是建筑用途的标志。

sentences.en: They're very overtly representational.
sentences.zh: 它们非常公开地具有具象代表性。

sentences.en: Like in a private home, the statues are of domestic scenes.
sentences.zh: 就像在私人住宅里，雕像是家庭场景。

sentences.en: Or on a market, they're of harvest and eating.
sentences.zh: 或者在市场上，它们是丰收和饮食。

sentences.en: For a government building, say San Francisco City Hall.
sentences.zh: 对于政府建筑，比如旧金山市政厅。

sentences.en: It's all going to tell us about, this is the seat of government and California is so great
sentences.zh: 这一切都在告诉我们，这是政府所在地，加州是如此伟大

sentences.en: and fabulous, but it's all going to be allegorical.
sentences.zh: 且美妙，但这一切都是寓言式的。

sentences.en: In a government building, you might find a statue of a woman holding an olive branch,
sentences.zh: 在政府建筑中，你可能会发现一个手持橄榄枝的女性雕像，

sentences.en: or the scales of justice representing the state, liberty, truth, you name it.
sentences.zh: 或是代表国家、自由、真理的正义天平，应有尽有。

sentences.en: Just women placed on this pedestal of virtue, morality, motherhood, nurturing, strength.
sentences.zh: 女性被置于美德、道德、母亲身份、培育、力量的高台之上。

sentences.en: Women decorated the seat of power.
sentences.zh: 女性装点着权力宝座。

sentences.en: They didn't sit in it.
sentences.zh: 但她们并不坐在上面。

sentences.en: Why's it got to be a lady?
sentences.zh: 为什么必须是女性？

sentences.en: Because women are pure.
sentences.zh: 因为女性是纯洁的。

sentences.en: You know, a woman with a spear, she would only use that spear to really defend her kids.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一个手持长矛的女性，她只会用那支长矛来真正保护她的孩子。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So it has to be, it has to be female.
sentences.zh: 所以它必须是，它必须是女性。

sentences.en: And for several years, this pure, uncorrupt symbol of virtue in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在好几年里，这个在美国纯洁、未被玷污的美德象征

sentences.en: was Audrey Munson.
sentences.zh: 就是奥黛丽·芒森。

sentences.en: She was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 她无处不在。

sentences.en: At the World's Fair in 1915, held in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 在1915年于旧金山举办的世界博览会上，

sentences.en: Audrey posed for three quarters of the statues on the premises.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽为场地内四分之三的雕像当了模特。

sentences.en: Her face and body appeared everywhere throughout the grounds.
sentences.zh: 她的面容和身体出现在展区的各个角落。

sentences.en: That's Erin Garcia of the California Historical Society.
sentences.zh: 这位是加州历史学会的埃林·加西亚。

sentences.en: She curated an exhibit about the 1915 Panama Pacific Exposition in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 她策划了一个关于1915年旧金山巴拿马太平洋万国博览会的展览，

sentences.en: where Audrey Munson was dubbed the Exposition Girl.
sentences.zh: 在会上，奥黛丽·芒森被誉为“世博会女孩”。

sentences.en: In the court of four seasons, she was the seasons.
sentences.zh: 在四季庭院，她就是四季。

sentences.en: She was at the base of the fountain of energy.
sentences.zh: 她位于能量喷泉的基座上。

sentences.en: She was rain.
sentences.zh: 她化身为雨。

sentences.en: She was the priestess of culture at the Palace of Fine Arts.
sentences.zh: 她是美术宫的文化女祭司。

sentences.en: She posed for 91 figures meant to represent the stars.
sentences.zh: 她为91尊旨在代表星星的人像当了模特。

sentences.en: She was all over the place.
sentences.zh: 她真是无处不在。

sentences.en: At about 24 years old, Miss Manhattan had won the West,
sentences.zh: 大约24岁时，“曼哈顿小姐”已经征服了西部，

sentences.en: and there was a new form of art entering the scene, cinema.
sentences.zh: 而一种新的艺术形式正在登上舞台，那就是电影。

sentences.en: The obvious next stop for Audrey Munson was Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽·芒森显而易见的下一站就是好莱坞。

sentences.en: And Hollywood was, unfortunately, the beginning of the end for Audrey Munson.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，好莱坞成为了奥黛丽·芒森走向毁灭的开始。

sentences.en: She is cast in a few films after the exposition,
sentences.zh: 在世博会之后，她参演了几部电影，

sentences.en: but in every case, she is cast as a nude model,
sentences.zh: 但在每部电影中，她都被塑造成一个裸体模特，

sentences.en: as an artist model, and she appears nude.
sentences.zh: 作为一个艺术家模特出场，并且她都是裸体出镜。

sentences.en: Audrey was actually the first leading woman in Hollywood to appear naked on film.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽实际上是好莱坞第一位在电影中裸体出镜的女主角。

sentences.en: And Audrey may have been a good model,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽可能是一个优秀的模特，

sentences.en: but she honestly wasn't much of an actress.
sentences.zh: 但她老实说确实算不上什么出色的演员。

sentences.en: In a few of her films, she actually had an acting double,
sentences.zh: 在她的一些电影中，她实际上有替身演员，

sentences.en: who would basically do everything except the naked posing.
sentences.zh: 基本上除了裸体摆姿势外，其他都由替身代劳。

sentences.en: And the movies didn't end up really being worth it for her financially.
sentences.zh: 而且从经济角度来看，这些电影对她来说并不算划算。

sentences.en: She was paid very little.
sentences.zh: 她的片酬非常低。

sentences.en: And none of them seemed to have been critical successes.
sentences.zh: 而且这些电影似乎没有一部获得口碑上的成功。

sentences.en: That might have been okay for her.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，这或许还能接受。

sentences.en: Her career might have survived that.
sentences.zh: 她的职业生涯或许本能挺过去。

sentences.en: But then, unfortunately, she was involved in a murder scandal.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，她卷入了一场谋杀丑闻。

sentences.en: Audrey and her mother had an apartment in New York,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽和母亲在纽约有一间公寓，

sentences.en: and their landlord, Dr. Wilkins, fell in love with Audrey.
sentences.zh: 她们的房东威尔金斯医生爱上了奥黛丽。

sentences.en: Her landlord apparently became obsessed with her
sentences.zh: 显然，房东对她产生了执念，

sentences.en: and killed his wife so that he could be with Audrey.
sentences.zh: 并杀害了自己的妻子，以便能和奥黛丽在一起。

sentences.en: Being with Audrey was a one-sided delusion.
sentences.zh: 和奥黛丽在一起只是他单方面的妄想。

sentences.en: Audrey had nothing to do with the murder or any kind of romance with Dr. Wilkins.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽与这场谋杀案毫无关系，也和威尔金斯医生没有任何浪漫情愫。

sentences.en: She and her mother had actually moved out of the home before this happened,
sentences.zh: 其实在这件事发生之前，她和母亲就已经搬出了那栋房子，

sentences.en: but they were questioned, they had to testify in court,
sentences.zh: 但她们还是受到了盘问，不得不在法庭上作证，

sentences.en: and they were sort of dragged through the mud in the press.
sentences.zh: 并且在某种程度上被媒体肆意抹黑。

sentences.en: The so-called Wilkins case became a phenomenal media scandal,
sentences.zh: 所谓的威尔金斯案成了一桩轰动的媒体丑闻，

sentences.en: as Audrey told the Daily Variety in 1920.
sentences.zh: 正如奥黛丽在1920年对《每日综艺报》所说的那样：

sentences.en: The Wilkins case ruined my career.
sentences.zh: 威尔金斯案毁了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I'll never account for anything again.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法取得任何成就了。

sentences.en: From loving and admiring me,
sentences.zh: 从爱戴和崇拜我，

sentences.en: the public seems to have grown to hate me.
sentences.zh: 公众似乎变得开始恨我了。

sentences.en: Audrey couldn't find any work,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽找不到任何工作，

sentences.en: in film or in artist studios.
sentences.zh: 无论是电影还是艺术家工作室。

sentences.en: But the decline of Audrey's career
sentences.zh: 但奥黛丽职业生涯的衰落，

sentences.en: wasn't just because of the Wilkins scandal.
sentences.zh: 并不仅仅是因为威尔金斯丑闻。

sentences.en: She was, after all, totally innocent.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，她是完全无辜的。

sentences.en: There were just a lot of factors changing in the culture around her.
sentences.zh: 只是她周围的文化环境发生了很多变化。

sentences.en: For one, the Beaux-Arts style wasn't very popular anymore.
sentences.zh: 首先，美术工艺风格不再那么受欢迎了。

sentences.en: The Beaux-Arts style came out of Europe,
sentences.zh: 美术工艺风格源自欧洲，

sentences.en: and there was this thing called World War I,
sentences.zh: 当时发生了第一次世界大战，

sentences.en: where Western Europe kind of fell apart.
sentences.zh: 西欧在某种程度上四分五裂。

sentences.en: And so there was a questioning about whether or not
sentences.zh: 因此人们开始质疑，

sentences.en: we want to be using that kind of symbolism.
sentences.zh: 我们是否还想要使用那种象征符号。

sentences.en: Both European and American architects were trending towards modernism,
sentences.zh: 无论是欧洲还是美国的建筑师，都开始走向现代主义，

sentences.en: away from the old world Beaux-Arts precedents.
sentences.zh: 告别了旧世界的美术工艺传统。

sentences.en: Also, the economics of Beaux-Arts style were impossible.
sentences.zh: 此外，美术工艺风格的经济账根本行不通。

sentences.en: It became increasingly expensive to construct these buildings
sentences.zh: 建造这些建筑的成本越来越高，

sentences.en: and pay for all of the artists and artisans
sentences.zh: 还要支付所有艺术家和工匠的费用，

sentences.en: to design all of the elements of the building and install it.
sentences.zh: 来设计建筑的所有元素并进行安装。

sentences.en: The architectural world didn't need Audrey like it used to.
sentences.zh: 建筑界不再像过去那样需要奥黛丽了。

sentences.en: And also, at 30, she was aging out of the business.
sentences.zh: 而且，到了30岁，她在这个行业里也开始显老了。

sentences.en: Audrey's 15-year career as an artist model had come to an end,
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽作为艺术模特的15年职业生涯已经走到了尽头，

sentences.en: and her money started to run out.
sentences.zh: 她的积蓄也开始耗尽。

sentences.en: She moved upstate with her mother,
sentences.zh: 她和母亲搬到了上州，

sentences.en: who cleaned homes to support them both
sentences.zh: 母亲靠帮人打扫房屋来维持两人的生计，

sentences.en: as they tried to carve out a place for themselves
sentences.zh: 当时她们试图在那个小小的农村小镇

sentences.en: in the small, rural town of Mexico, New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约州墨西哥镇安身立命。

sentences.en: It's not an kind of open, easygoing place.
sentences.zh: 那可不是一个开放、随和的地方。

sentences.en: Andrea Geyer went up there to talk to people about Audrey.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·盖尔去那里跟人们聊起奥黛丽的事。

sentences.en: Nobody was unfriendly to me,
sentences.zh: 没有人对我表现得不友善，

sentences.en: but there's something about these close-knit communities
sentences.zh: 但这些紧密团结的社区有一种氛围，

sentences.en: where, as a stranger, you don't feel welcomed.
sentences.zh: 作为外人，你会觉得不受欢迎。

sentences.en: Audrey could not get used to small-town life.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽无法习惯小镇生活。

sentences.en: Her whole adulthood, she had been traveling around the country,
sentences.zh: 她的整个成年时期都在全国各地奔波，

sentences.en: studying art, working with artists,
sentences.zh: 研究艺术、与艺术家合作、

sentences.en: engaging in intellectual discussions,
sentences.zh: 参与知识分子的讨论，

sentences.en: and wearing fine clothes.
sentences.zh: 穿着华丽的衣服。

sentences.en: And suddenly, she lost it all.
sentences.zh: 而突然之间，她这一切都失去了。

sentences.en: Well, she still had the clothes.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她至少还留着那些衣服。

sentences.en: People told me that she was very flamboyant.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我她非常张扬。

sentences.en: She liked to dress up in colorful garments.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢穿色彩斑斓的衣服。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm sure she had a pretty impressive wardrobe
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我敢肯定她有一个相当惊艳的衣橱，

sentences.en: that was very outlandish for a small community.
sentences.zh: 对于一个小社区来说这非常奇特出挑。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just Audrey's style that set her apart.
sentences.zh: 但让奥黛丽与众不同的不仅仅是她的风格。

sentences.en: She would dress up on that,
sentences.zh: 她不仅穿成那样，

sentences.en: and then part of her workout routine in the city was roller skating.
sentences.zh: 而且她在城里的健身日常之一就是溜冰。

sentences.en: So, you know, you can imagine a beautiful woman with long hair
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以想象一个留着长发的美丽女人，

sentences.en: and a turban on her head, you know,
sentences.zh: 头上戴着头巾，

sentences.en: trying to roller skate on a country, unpaved country road.
sentences.zh: 试图在乡村的未铺沥青的乡间小路上溜冰。

sentences.en: That was quite a scene.
sentences.zh: 那真是一番奇景。

sentences.en: The town knew Audrey as that crazy woman
sentences.zh: 镇上的人都知道奥黛丽是个疯女人，

sentences.en: who used to get naked for money.
sentences.zh: 以前靠脱衣服赚钱。

sentences.en: Parents would close their windows whenever she came roller skating by.
sentences.zh: 每当她溜冰路过时，父母们都会关上窗户。

sentences.en: The kids, of course, were totally fascinated with her.
sentences.zh: 孩子们当然对她着迷不已。

sentences.en: But there was a general consensus that she was crazy,
sentences.zh: 但大家的普遍共识是她疯了，

sentences.en: just because she was different.
sentences.zh: 只因为她与众不同。

sentences.en: So it's not hard to imagine why she would have fallen into a depression.
sentences.zh: 所以不难想象她为什么会陷入抑郁。

sentences.en: And on May 27, 1922, Audrey Munson attempted suicide by swallowing poison.
sentences.zh: 1922年5月27日，奥黛丽·曼森吞服毒药试图自杀。

sentences.en: I don't know how committed her suicide attempt was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她这次自杀尝试有多坚决。

sentences.en: Maybe it was just an expression of being somewhere at the end of her line.
sentences.zh: 也许这只是她走投无路的一种宣泄。

sentences.en: After her failed suicide attempt, several years went by,
sentences.zh: 在自杀未遂几年后，

sentences.en: and Audrey's mother was struggling to provide for her depressed daughter.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽的母亲艰难地照顾着陷入抑郁的女儿。

sentences.en: And she just couldn't do it anymore.
sentences.zh: 而她实在无能为力了。

sentences.en: On Audrey Munson's 40th birthday, June 8, 1931,
sentences.zh: 在奥黛丽·曼森40岁生日那天，即1931年6月8日，

sentences.en: her mother checked her into the state mental institution.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲把她送进了州立精神病院。

sentences.en: At that time, it was extremely common for families
sentences.zh: 在当时，家庭在面临经济困境、

sentences.en: to put relatives into these institutions
sentences.zh: 觉得无法照顾某位亲属时，

sentences.en: in moments of financial hardship,
sentences.zh: 将其送入这类机构是非常普遍的做法。

sentences.en: where they felt they couldn't care for a person.
sentences.zh: 而她感到无力照料对方。

sentences.en: Audrey remained in the institution into her 90s.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽在精神病院里一直住到90多岁。

sentences.en: Then she was put in a nursing home about 30 miles up the road.
sentences.zh: 后来她被转移到大约30英里外的一家疗养院。

sentences.en: But this home for the elderly was situated on this little four-lane highway.
sentences.zh: 但这家养老院恰好坐落在一个小小的四车道高速公路旁。

sentences.en: And on the other side of the highway was a little strip mall,
sentences.zh: 高速公路的对面是一个小小的商业街区，

sentences.en: which had a bar.
sentences.zh: 里面有一家酒吧。

sentences.en: And she was known to sneak out of the home for the elderly
sentences.zh: 据说到头来她经常从养老院偷溜出去，

sentences.en: and sneak across the four-lane highway
sentences.zh: 偷偷穿过四车道的高速公路，

sentences.en: to spend her evenings at the bar ordering drinks
sentences.zh: 把夜晚的时间花在酒吧里点酒喝，

sentences.en: and telling stories of her times as a model and as an actress.
sentences.zh: 并讲述她过去当模特和演员的故事。

sentences.en: They could not stop this 90-something, elegant older woman
sentences.zh: 人们无法阻止这位90多岁、优雅的老年妇女

sentences.en: from running across four lanes of traffic to go to the bar.
sentences.zh: 奔过四车道车流去酒吧。

sentences.en: It sadly meant that they put her back into the mental institution
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这意味着他们把她重新送回了精神病院，

sentences.en: where she, you know, spent the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 她在那里度过了余生。

sentences.en: Audrey Munson lived just short of her 105th birthday.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽·曼森离105岁生日只差几天。

sentences.en: She died in 1996.
sentences.zh: 她于1996年去世。

sentences.en: This public body that once represented truth, civic fame, memory,
sentences.zh: 这个曾代表真理、公民名誉、记忆、

sentences.en: the universe, and the stars
sentences.zh: 宇宙和群星的公共雕像，

sentences.en: was hidden away for nearly two-thirds of her life.
sentences.zh: 在她近三分之二的生命中都被隐藏了起来。

sentences.en: But that one-third, that glorious third,
sentences.zh: 但那辉煌的三分之一，

sentences.en: immortalized her and placed her all over American cities,
sentences.zh: 使她流芳百世，伫立在美国各地的城市中，

sentences.en: perched high, quietly, out of sight, staring down at us.
sentences.zh: 高高在上，静静地、隐匿在视线之外，俯视着我们。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if many of my readers have not stood before
sentences.zh: 我在想，我的许多读者是否也曾驻足于

sentences.en: a masterpiece of lovely sculpture
sentences.zh: 精美的雕塑杰作

sentences.en: or a remarkable painting of a young girl
sentences.zh: 或一幅非凡的少女画作前，

sentences.en: and asked themselves the question,
sentences.zh: 心里暗自琢磨：

sentences.en: where is she now?
sentences.zh: 她现在在哪里？

sentences.en: This model who was so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这位曾如此美丽的模特。

sentences.en: What has been her reward?
sentences.zh: 她得到了什么回报？

sentences.en: Is she happy and prosperous?
sentences.zh: 她过得幸福美满吗？

sentences.en: Or is she sad and forlorn?
sentences.zh: 还是悲伤而落魄？

sentences.en: Her beauty gone,
sentences.zh: 她的美貌已然消逝，

sentences.en: leaving only memories in the wake.
sentences.zh: 只留下无尽的回忆。

sentences.zh: 以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。
